author: kilo-code-bot
body:
**SUGGESTION:** Header comment still claims every write requires `content-type: application/json`

This sentence was rewritten in this PR but kept the "writes additionally require `content-type: application/json`" wording, while commit 2 corrected the exact same claim in `specs/sessions/bro-f4ot/spec.md` to scope the content-type gate to body-bearing writes. The implementation agrees with the corrected spec: `WRITE_METHODS` treats DELETE as a write (Origin allowlist applies), but the content-type gate only runs for POST/PUT/PATCH (`wantsBody`). Restating the spec's corrected phrasing here — Origin allowlist on all four write methods, content-type only for POST/PUT/PATCH — keeps the two documentation surfaces from drifting apart again.

---
Reply with `@kilocode-bot fix it` to have Kilo Code address this issue.
